claims.text: What the strip looks like A pacing spike with no depolarization after it.
claims.quote: Failure to capture: Spike without following depolarization (lead dislodgement, battery depletion, electrolytes)

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Pacing spike: present, but no depolarization follows it
claims.quote: Failure to capture: Spike without following depolarization (lead dislodgement, battery depletion, electrolytes)

claims.text: Example: a ventricular paced rhythm with intermittent failure to capture; atrial sensing appears intact (a ventricular pacing spike follows each P wave)
claims.quote: This ECG shows a ventricular paced rhythm with intermittent failure to capture: Atrial sensing appears to be intact — ventricular pacing spikes follow each P wave

claims.text: When it can't be seen: if the native rate is above the pacemaker threshold, no pacing is expected, so capture failure cannot be recognized on the ECG
claims.quote: NB. If the patient's native heart rate is above the pacemaker threshold, no pacemaker activity is expected and therefore output failure and capture failure cannot be recognised on the ECG.

claims.text: Causes (mechanism and diagnoses) Mechanism: the paced stimulus does not depolarize the myocardium
claims.quote: Failure to capture occurs when paced stimulus does not result in myocardial depolarisation
Failure to capture: Spike without following depolarization (lead dislodgement, battery depletion, electrolytes)

claims.text: Also electrode displacement, wire fracture, electrolyte disturbance, MI or exit block
claims.quote: Multiple causes including electrode displacement, wire fracture, electrolyte disturbance, MI or exit block

claims.text: Symptoms Often non-specific symptoms; the ECG changes can be subtle or absent
claims.quote: Diagnosis of pacemaker malfunction is challenging and often associated with non-specific clinical symptoms while ECG changes can be subtle or absent

claims.text: Treatment Suspected malfunction needs cardiology review for pacemaker interrogation and testing
claims.quote: If pacemaker malfunction is suspected cardiology review is required to facilitate pacemaker interrogation and testing

claims.text: For a dislodged lead, a chest x-ray will usually help confirm the diagnosis
claims.quote: A chest x-ray will usually help to confirm the diagnosis
